symptom: A `call external action` whose object parameter has "Associations to include" ticked in Studio Pro loses them on every `create or modify microflow` that restates the call: the OData request then carries only the object's own attributes and silently drops the associated objects at runtime. DESCRIBE shows nothing, and check, lint and docker check all pass.
file: mdl/executor/external_action_carry.go (carryIncludedAssociations, wired in cmd_microflows_build.go); mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_read_actions.go (includedAssociationsFromGen); mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_external_action_write.go (includedAssociationsToGen, marker-2 lists); sdk/microflows ExternalActionParameterMapping.IncludedAssociations
cause: The semantic model had no field for Microflows$ExternalActionParameterMapping.IncludedAssociations, the reader did not read it, callExternalActionToGen built each mapping from scratch, and the rebuild had no MDL to take it from. Same class as rewrite-drops-unauthored-state.
insight: **The report called it a boolean flag; it is a tree.** The Studio Pro reference (ako/TestApp Odata.IncludeAssociationsMF, 11.16.0 Beta) stores a list of Microflows$IncludedAssociation {Association, IncludedAssociations, IsParent} per parameter mapping, an association ticked under another nested in its IncludedAssociations; marker 2 at both levels; IsParent true where the object on that side is the association's FROM (ParentPointer) entity. The control microflow (_Off, nothing ticked) differs only in that list, so one property is the whole test. Building the reference took two contracts: Studio Pro refuses a ComplexType action parameter (R017 "One of the parameters is not supported"), so the reporter's DTOs are entity types without an entity set. **Matching stored to rebuilt calls cannot use position**: a flow's stored object order is Studio Pro's, not the statement's. The carry keys on service.action and parameter name; when two stored calls to one action hold different trees it refuses, and a shared tree carried twice gets fresh $IDs on the second copy. A tree is not carried onto a parameter whose resolved entity changed. **Under `mdl 1;` the rewrite usually does not reach the rebuild at all**: create or modify splices into the stored flow by re-parsing DESCRIBE's output, and for this reference that output is `additional = )` (Studio Pro 11.16 stored an unfilled nullable argument as "", which DESCRIBE prints bare), so every mdl-1 rewrite of the microflow is refused before anything is lost; the carry covers headerless scripts and the rebuild fallback. ALTER passes the untouched call through as stored bytes and was never affected. **mx check could not be the end-to-end check**: Studio Pro 11.16.0 Beta's mx crashes (NullReferenceException in DocumentCheck) on the untouched TestApp too. Controls: disabling the carry call fails TestCreateOrModify_CarriesIncludedAssociations; disabling the writer's list fails TestCallExternalAction_IncludedAssociationsRoundTrip on the On fixture while the Off fixture passes. **Left out on purpose**: AdditionalAttributes (no reference holds one), the action-level IncludedAssociations (empty in both references), and the empty marker lists Studio Pro writes on every mapping (version-gated: 10.11+ / 11.5+, unwritten since #1073).
